note: Source-linked public exercises. No mentoring sessions or paid services included. Follow the original author instructions.

projects.title: 24-week Cybersecurity GRC Mentorship Portfolio
projects.description: A public set of 24 weekly assignments, learning guides, checklists and a four-week enterprise capstone. Mentorship is not included.

projects.title: Norvela: 12-week end-to-end GRC lab
projects.description: A connected fictitious company, workbooks and technical lab with seven phases after setup, deliverables and proof gates. Optional Docker setup.

projects.title: Week 01: Introduction to Cybersecurity GRC
projects.description: Compare common security and compliance frameworks for a fictional SaaS client.

projects.title: Week 02: Risk Management Fundamentals
projects.description: Work through a client risk assessment scenario.

projects.title: Week 03: Security Governance Frameworks
projects.description: Develop governance recommendations using a simulated organization.

projects.title: Week 04: Introduction to Compliance Programs
projects.description: Plan compliance activities for a fictional company.

projects.title: Week 05: ISO 27001:2022 Deep Dive
projects.description: Work through an ISO 27001 implementation and gap-assessment scenario.

projects.title: Week 06: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0
projects.description: Apply NIST CSF 2.0 to a fictional organization.

projects.title: Week 07: Security Policy Development
projects.description: Draft and review policies in a client scenario.

projects.title: Week 08: Vendor Risk Management
projects.description: Practice supplier due diligence and vendor risk assessment.

projects.title: Week 09: SOC 2 and Cloud Compliance
projects.description: Assess a SaaS company's SOC 2 readiness and cloud controls.

projects.title: Week 10: GDPR and Data Privacy Compliance
projects.description: Practice privacy compliance assessment in a healthcare scenario.

projects.title: Week 11: Internal Security Audit Fundamentals
projects.description: Plan and document an internal security audit.

projects.title: Week 12: Control Testing and Evidence Management
projects.description: Practice test design, evidence collection and workpaper documentation.

projects.title: Week 13: Business Impact Analysis
projects.description: Analyze business processes and recovery needs in a logistics scenario.

projects.title: Week 14: Incident Response and GRC Oversight
projects.description: Practice GRC oversight during an incident scenario.

projects.title: Week 15: Security Metrics and Executive Reporting
projects.description: Create security metrics and management reporting.

projects.title: Week 16: CIS Controls and Cross-Framework Mapping
projects.description: Map security controls across different frameworks.

projects.title: Week 17: Enterprise Risk Assessment Program
projects.description: Develop a risk assessment approach for a fictional bank.

projects.title: Week 18: GRC Program Management
projects.description: Plan and manage a comprehensive GRC program.

projects.title: Week 19: Cloud and AI Security Governance
projects.description: Address cloud and AI governance in a client scenario.

projects.title: Week 21: Capstone: Enterprise GRC Strategy & Governance
projects.description: Develop an enterprise governance strategy for fictional NovaTech.

projects.title: Week 22: Capstone: Risk Management & Policy Library
projects.description: Develop risk and policy deliverables for NovaTech.

projects.title: Week 23: Capstone: Compliance, Audit & Vendor Programs
projects.description: Develop audit, compliance and supplier assessment workstreams.

projects.title: Week 24: Capstone: Metrics Dashboard & Final Presentation
projects.description: Prepare executive metrics and a final client presentation.

projects.title: Norvela Phase 0: Set up and orient
projects.description: Explore the company dossier, configure tools and prepare an observations memo.

projects.title: Norvela Phase 1: Governance and risk foundations
projects.description: Critique and rebuild a flawed risk register and governance pack.

projects.title: Norvela Phase 2: Scoping and Statement of Applicability
projects.description: Define regulatory boundaries and produce an ISO 27001 Statement of Applicability.

projects.title: Norvela Phase 3: Control assessment and evidence
projects.description: Test controls against provided identities, assets and vulnerability findings.

projects.title: Norvela Phase 4: Third-party risk and DORA register
projects.description: Assess vendors and build a DORA register of information.

projects.title: Norvela Phase 5: Incident, continuity and regulatory clock
projects.description: Respond to a timed simulated incident and document decisions.

projects.title: Norvela Phase 6: Reporting, audit and the board
projects.description: Bring assessment findings into board-level reporting.

projects.title: Norvela Phase 7: Interview conversion
projects.description: Practice explaining and defending completed GRC work.

projects.title: Cloud Cybersecurity: risk and compliance capstone
projects.description: Free 10-hour course covering NIST CSF, HIPAA, SOC, IAM and incident response, with a cloud security capstone scenario. External lab access may have separate terms.

projects.title: Information Security certification projects
projects.description: Free project-based information security curriculum with practical security exercises. Technical security rather than GRC-specific.

projects.title: MCP Security Fundamentals: AI governance
projects.description: Free two-hour course on MCP security risks, governance, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001 and the EU AI Act. Learning resource, not a guided portfolio project.

projects.title: API Security for PCI DSS 4.0
projects.description: Free course on API risks and PCI DSS 4.0 requirements. Useful background for compliance and control assessment, not a guided portfolio project.

projects.title: Microsoft Security, Compliance and Identity Fundamentals (SC-900)
projects.description: Free exam-preparation course covering Zero Trust, Microsoft compliance, data governance and identity. The certification exam itself is not free.

projects.title: Learn Web Security in TypeScript
projects.description: Web security course covering authentication, authorization, secure storage and incident response. Free read-only lessons and limited interactive trial; full interactive work requires paid membership.

projects.title: DevOps path: security, CI/CD and cloud controls
projects.description: Technical DevOps pathway with CI/CD, Kubernetes and web security. Relevant to understanding control implementation; full interactive work requires paid membership.

projects.title: AI for Cybersecurity Series
projects.description: 17-course pathway covering AI risk governance, NIST AI RMF, prompt injection, adversarial threats, and AI-assisted security operations. Individual course certificates, no overall Series credential.

projects.title: AI for Business Leadership Series
projects.description: 25-course pathway on AI strategy, organizational oversight, responsible AI, risk management and change leadership. Includes capstone activities.

projects.title: AI for Data Analytics Series
projects.description: 13-course pathway on data quality, AI-assisted analysis, dashboards and forecasting. Useful for GRC metrics and continuous monitoring, not a dedicated GRC course.

projects.title: AI for Software Development Series
projects.description: Role-based AI-assisted development pathway on using coding agents, testing and verifying generated software. Relevant to GRC automation, not a dedicated GRC course.

projects.title: Certified AI Guardrail Engineer: free training and practice exam
projects.description: 43 sections across seven domains covering AI threat modeling, security, safety, containment, evaluation and governance. Includes a free 75-question practice exam. Formal Associate and Professional certification exams are still in development.
projects.access: Free training and practice exam · certification not yet available

projects.title: AI Guardrail Engineer: seven hands-on labs
projects.description: Harden a deliberately vulnerable multi-tenant AI support agent across seven practical labs. Practice containment, threat modeling, control implementation and evaluation. Formal certification exams are not yet available.
